title: Joe Rogan Experience #1258 - Jack Dorsey, Vijaya Gadde & Tim Pool
summary: A three-hour-plus Joe Rogan podcast with Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey, policy lead Vijaya Gadde and journalist Tim Pool. They discuss Twitter's moderation, bans and rule enforcement, with Pool challenging Dorsey and Gadde with examples.
why: HN people cite it as insight into how Twitter thought about moderation, and as a source for Tim Pool's arguments about uneven enforcement.

quote.text: provided a lot of insight into how Twitter thought about moderation. It was a lot more nuanced than I expected.
